name: sdp
description: SDP plugin for AI assistants. Build websites and administer product, listing, and custom-order catalogs through hosted MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Website builder and catalogs for SDP
interface.longDescription: Connect an SDP account to build websites with Latte components and administer products, listings, and custom-order types through hosted MCP. Authenticate with OAuth. Never invent catalog ids or type slugs.
defaultPrompt: List my SDP websites and describe the current theme framework.
Create a draft listings page that uses {sdpGetListings}.
Add a product with a public image URL through Products MCP.
